title: ESM-Catalog Production Requirements
description: DRAFT. Production-only requirements for a valid ESM-Tools STAC catalog, recovered from the deleted src/esm_catalog/context.py production checkers. This profile expresses ONLY the requirements that pystac.validate() and the pydantic models do not already enforce: PI/author contacts on the experiment and the fields each contact must carry. context.py enforced these at the CollectionContext (whole-experiment) level, so this profile targets the Collection. Contacts are experiment-wide and are not stamped on individual Items, so there is no Item requirement here. STAC-core required fields (Collection description/license/extent) are not restated because pystac.validate() already enforces them. Apply this in addition to pystac.validate(), and only in 'production' mode (the dev path leaves contacts optional).

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: PI/author contacts for the experiment. context.py required at least one contact in production ('Production context requires at least one contact').

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A single PI or author contact, in STAC contacts-extension serialized form (Contact.to_stac(): name, roles, identifier=orcid, organization=institution). context.py's Contact.PRODUCTION_REQUIRED was ['name', 'institution']; 'institution' serializes to 'organization'.

name.title: Name
name.description: Full name of the contact. Required in production (context.py Contact.PRODUCTION_REQUIRED).

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Affiliated institution (Contact.institution). Required in production (context.py Contact.PRODUCTION_REQUIRED, ['name', 'institution']).

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: ORCID identifier (Contact.orcid), serialized as the full https://orcid.org/ URL. Optional.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: STAC contact roles; defaults to ['principal_investigator']. Optional.
